props.vertexShader:
#include <common>
void main() { gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position * float( FIXTURE_SCALE ), 1.0 ); }

#if __VERSION__ == 300
#define FIXTURE_VERSION_SCALE 0.3
#else
#define FIXTURE_VERSION_SCALE 0.9
#endif
#ifdef GL_ES
#define FIXTURE_ENV_SCALE 1.0
#else
#define FIXTURE_ENV_SCALE 2.0
#endif
uniform float fixtureGain;
varying vec3 fixtureVarying;
void main() { fixtureVarying = position * FIXTURE_VERSION_SCALE; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position * fixtureGain * FIXTURE_ENV_SCALE, 1.0 ); }
